stemMd: A study finds that teams with more meetings finish projects later. A manager proposes cancelling meetings to speed delivery. Which possibility most undermines that inference?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Difficult projects may require both more meetings and more time.

explanationMd: Project difficulty can be a common cause of both meeting frequency and delayed completion. If so, eliminating meetings may not remove the source of delay and could impair coordination. The correlation alone does not identify meetings as the cause.

distractorRationale.b: This does not explain the association.
distractorRationale.e: Preference is not evidence about the observed relationship.
